alerts.description: Objects reconcile found in quarantine in place of the recorded ones.

Alert.description:
Another object was found in quarantine in place of the one a boot-time move recorded: Purge moved
it back, or kept it there because it could not (review M3-R2 S5, ruling 1).

moved_back.description:
Whether the other object was moved back to `original_path`; `false` when it is kept in
quarantine.

op.description: The op whose boot-time move this reconcile looked at.

original_path.description: The source path the boot-time move was to take.

OpId.description:
The number of one op within a session, counted from 1 in plan order.

Every selected plan item gets an op id, whether or not it ends up acted on. The id also names the op's
directory and backup files, through [`OpId::file_stem`]. Reading `0` fails: no op has that id. That
an id is at most the header's item count is checked where the journal is read.

Outcome.description: What a run did. Carried by results; not an error.

oneOf.description: Some items are held or failed; the result names them and what holds them.
An undo restored what it could and lists conflicts.
The session was not recorded completely; History offers recovery. Wins over the two above.
